name: Output
description: Goods and services produced within an establishment that become available for use outside it

name: Intermediate consumption
description: Goods and services consumed as inputs by a process of production

name: Value added; gross
description: Output less intermediate consumption; before deduction of consumption of fixed capital

name: Consumption of fixed capital
description: Decline in the value of fixed assets used in production during the period

name: Value added; net
description: Gross value added less consumption of fixed capital

name: Gross domestic product
description: GDP at market prices; the headline aggregate of all three approaches

name: Taxes on products
description: Taxes payable per unit of a good or service produced or transacted

name: Subsidies on products
description: Subsidies payable per unit of a good or service produced or imported

name: Taxes on production and imports
description: Taxes on products plus other taxes on production

name: Other taxes on production
description: Taxes on production other than taxes on products

name: Subsidies
description: Subsidies on products plus other subsidies on production

name: Other subsidies on production
description: Subsidies on production other than subsidies on products

name: Compensation of employees
description: Total remuneration payable by an employer to an employee for work done

name: Wages and salaries
description: Compensation of employees excluding employers' social contributions

name: Employers' social contributions
description: Social contributions payable by employers on behalf of employees

name: Operating surplus; gross
description: Surplus accruing from production before deduction of consumption of fixed capital

name: Mixed income; gross
description: Surplus of unincorporated enterprises owned by households; includes an unseparable labour element

name: Final consumption expenditure
description: Expenditure on goods and services used to satisfy individual or collective needs

name: Individual consumption expenditure
description: Final consumption expenditure on individual goods and services

name: Collective consumption expenditure
description: Government final consumption expenditure on collective services

name: Actual final consumption
description: Consumption of goods and services acquired; including social transfers in kind

name: Gross fixed capital formation
description: Acquisitions less disposals of fixed assets during the period

name: Changes in inventories
description: Value of entries into less withdrawals from inventories; plus recurrent losses

name: Acquisitions less disposals of valuables
description: Net acquisitions of stores of value such as precious metals and art

name: Exports of goods and services
description: Sales; barter or transfers of goods and services from residents to non-residents

name: Imports of goods and services
description: Purchases; barter or transfers of goods and services from non-residents to residents

name: Total population
description: Mid-year (or period-average) resident population. A memorandum item; never summed into an aggregate; used only as the denominator of per-capita measures

name: FISIM output, total
sna2008_ref: SNA 2008 ch.6 and ch.17 (this system’s code)
description: Total FISIM produced by financial corporations; already included in their P.1. The allocations below must sum to this figure.

name: FISIM allocated to intermediate consumption
sna2008_ref: SNA 2008 ch.6 and ch.17 (this system’s code)
description: FISIM consumed by a producing industry; carries that industry. GDP-neutral.

name: FISIM in household final consumption
sna2008_ref: SNA 2008 ch.6 and ch.17 (this system’s code)
description: FISIM consumed by households as final consumers. Final use; raises GDP.

name: FISIM in government final consumption
sna2008_ref: SNA 2008 ch.6 and ch.17 (this system’s code)
description: FISIM consumed by general government. Final use; raises GDP.

name: FISIM exported
sna2008_ref: SNA 2008 ch.6 and ch.17 (this system’s code)
description: FISIM supplied to non-residents. Final use; raises GDP.

name: Imputed output of owner-occupied dwelling services
description: Housing services produced and consumed by owner-occupiers; carries the industry that records them.

name: Intermediate consumption of owner-occupied dwelling services
description: Inputs to the imputed production above; must carry the same industry as IMPRENT.P1.
